name: poor-richard
tagline_zh: 写代码时最烦的不是算法，是「瑞士的货币代码到底是 CHF 还是 CHW」这种一查就打断心流的问题。
tagline_en: The annoying part of coding isn't the algorithm, it's 'is Switzerland CHF or CHW?'. 43 authoritative libraries.
desc_en: Offline almanack of 43 curated Python libraries answering factual questions - ISO country/language/currency codes, physical constants, unit conversions, holiday and exchange business-day calendars, celestial ephemerides, checksum validation (IBAN, ISIN, ISBN, Luhn), chemical and particle data, financial product classification. Use when asked a factual question in these domains and an authoritative
why_zh: 不是又一个 API 封装，而是把 43 个各自为政的权威数据源收进一个入口，按问题域分派。断网可用。
why_en: Not another API wrapper: 43 authoritative sources behind one entry point, routed by domain. Works offline, answers are.
limit_zh: 只覆盖它收录的那 43 个库的领域：问历史事件、法律条文、实时汇率它答不了。数据随库版本冻结。
limit_en: Covers only the 43 bundled libraries' domains: no history, law, or live FX rates. Data is frozen at library version; holiday and rate tables need.
title_en: 43 offline Python libraries for facts you'd rather not guess
